name: Bubble Mastery II
description: When an enemy breaks your Bubble, its remaining magic retaliates for 15 damage.
flavor:
Your Bubble finally pops.

There is a brief, deeply offended silence.

Then the remaining Astral energy launches directly back at your foe.

Your Bubble bursts with an indignant *BOING!* and fires the last of its magic directly at your foe.

Apparently this was personal.

Your Bubble breaks.

It has had enough.
